title: Most goals at one World Cup since 1994
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals at a single World Cup from 1994 to 2026, counting each player's best tournament once.

notes.Miroslav Klose: Miroslav Klose's best was 5 (2002 and 2006), just outside.
notes.Thomas Muller: Thomas Muller's best was 5 (2010 and 2014), just outside.
notes.Roberto Baggio: Roberto Baggio scored 5 in 1994, just outside.

notes.Gabriel Batistuta: Gabriel Batistuta scored 5 in 1998, just outside.
